title: Consider the impact of a larger sample size
text: Think about how increasing the sample size from $$100$$ to $$200$$ might affect the response bias. Would it make the survey results more or less representative of the entire student population?

title: Think about the effect of reminder emails
text: Consider how sending a reminder email to students who didn't respond initially might influence the response rate and bias. Would this change the likelihood of getting a more representative sample?
